notes: Big Oona (bible 5.14), dockhand and arm-wrestling champion of the Drowned Gull. Voice: loud, cheerful, bossy, teasing; 'love'. Tidefair barks (bible 6.1 quest 7). Class greetings only. The match itself is a hook: ask-wrestle emits armwrestle.requested, consumed by the Drowned Gull gameplay bead (mw-e40.6); the match, stakes and brawl are out of scope.

nodes.speaker: oona
nodes.text: A knight! Good. Finally, someone with a grip. Big Oona, champion of the Drowned Gull, and I've not lost a table since the autumn before last. Sit, if you dare.

nodes.speaker: oona
nodes.text: An archer. Soft hands. Lovely. Hands that can hit a gull at forty paces can't hold a table. Come on, have a go, I'll go easy. I won't.

nodes.speaker: oona
nodes.text: Oh, a spellcaster! No magic at the table, love. The last one froze my elbow and I broke his chair. Sit, drink, and keep your fingers where I can see them.

nodes.speaker: oona
nodes.text: Hands in the open, pickpocket, I know the look. Don't take anything off my table. I've two arms and a lot of friends. Sit, if you like.

nodes.speaker: oona
nodes.text: Big Oona! Champion of the Drowned Gull and the Stone Wharf, the arm-wrestling table's right there. Sit, put your elbow down, and let's see what you're made of.

nodes.speaker: oona
nodes.text: Back for another go? That's the spirit. Table's warm.

options.text: I hear a tavern brawl can start in here.
What's Nell like to work for?

nodes.speaker: oona
nodes.text: Come back when your arm's stronger! I'll be here. I'm always here. It's a very good table.

nodes.speaker: oona
nodes.text: Elbow here, love, thumb up, and don't tell your mother. Ready? Three, two, one, and go!

nodes.speaker: oona
nodes.text: Every market day the Stone Wharf's a riot. Arm-wrestling, that's me. The Gull Shoot, with wooden gulls on a boom. The Regatta, no magic, which means magic. And the Pocket Race. Hide your purse for that one.

nodes.speaker: oona
nodes.text: Oh, it only takes one. Someone loses badly, someone laughs, someone's chair is suddenly in the air. If you lose gracefully, I'll buy you a drink and the Gull warms to you anyway. If you lose badly, run.

nodes.speaker: oona
nodes.text: Nell? She pays on time and hides in the cellar when Cray's about. That's all I know and all I'll say. Loud mouth, soft heart, and three hundred ways to lose a bet.
